cards.text:
While this ice is protecting HQ, the Runner cannot break more than 1 of its printed subroutines during each encounter.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 2[credit].
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.title: Afshar

cards.text: Run any server. When that run ends, if it was unsuccessful, you may run the attacked server again, ignoring any additional costs to run. During the second run, whenever you encounter the last piece of ice you encountered during the first run, bypass it.
cards.title: Always Have a Backup Plan

cards.text: When you score this agenda, look at the top 5 cards of R&D. You may install and rez 1 of those cards, ignoring all costs.
cards.title: Architect Deployment Test

cards.text: The first job resource, connection resource, or piece of hardware you install each turn costs 1[credit] less to install.
cards.title: Az McCaffrey: Mechanical Prodigy

cards.text: The first time you encounter a piece of ice during each run, place 1 power counter on this resource. [trash], X hosted power counters: Derez the ice you are encountering if its strength is X or less. Take 1 tag.
cards.title: “Baklan” Bochkin

cards.text: Look at the top 2 cards of your stack. You may add 1 of those cards to the bottom of your stack. Draw 2 cards.
cards.title: Blueberry!™ Diesel

cards.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength. The first time each turn this program fully breaks a piece of ice, gain 2[credit].
cards.title: Bukhgalter

cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Draw 2 cards. When the Runner trashes this asset, you may draw 2 cards.
cards.title: Calvin B4L3Y

cards.text:
Install only on a piece of ice.
Host ice gets −1 strength for each hosted virus counter.
Whenever you encounter host ice, if its strength is 0 or less, trash it. Otherwise, place 1 virus counter on this program.
cards.title: Chisel

cards.text: When your turn begins, remove this resource from the game. Choose a server protected by ice. The Corp may trash 1 piece of ice protecting that server. If they do not, the first time this turn you breach either R&D or HQ, access 2 additional cards.
cards.title: Climactic Showdown

cards.text: [click]: Place 1 power counter on this upgrade. As an additional cost to run this server, the Runner must spend [click] and 1[credit] for each hosted power counter. When your turn begins, remove all hosted power counters.
cards.title: Cold Site Server

cards.text:
Play only if the Runner has 3 or more agenda points and they made a successful run during their last turn.
After you resolve this operation, your action phase ends.
Choose a card name, then do 1 net damage. If you trash a card with the chosen name this way, repeat this process.
cards.title: Complete Image

cards.text:
When the Runner passes this ice, gain 1[credit].
[subroutine] Gain 2[credit]. The Runner gains 1[credit].
cards.title: Congratulations!

cards.text: When your turn begins, you may draw 1 card.
cards.title: CSR Campaign

cards.text:
Rez only during your action phase.
Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, they gain 2[credit].
When your turn begins, if the Runner did not make a successful run on this server during their last turn, gain 3[credit].
cards.title: Daily Quest

cards.text: +1[mu] The trash cost of each Corp card is lowered by 1[credit]. The first time each turn you trash a Corp card, gain 1[credit]. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.title: Demolisher

cards.text:
While you are resolving this event, each playerʼs identity loses all abilities.
Run any server. When that run ends, you may shuffle this event into your stack.
cards.title: Direct Access

cards.text: Whenever the Runner steals another agenda, you may forfeit this agenda to gain 5[credit] and add the stolen agenda to HQ.
cards.title: Divested Trust

cards.text:
When your turn begins and whenever you steal an agenda, place 1[credit] on this resource.
Whenever you make a successful run, you can spend hosted credits for the remainder of that run.
When your turn ends, if there are 3 or more hosted credits, you must pay 1[credit] or trash this resource.
cards.title: Fencer Fueno

cards.text: Use this hardware only during your turn. [trash]: Jack out. [trash]: Remove 1 tag. [interrupt] → [trash]: Reduce the base trace strength of a trace to 0.
cards.title: Flip Switch

cards.text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Choose a card type, then reveal the grip. Choose a value for X equal to or less than the number of revealed cards of the chosen type. You may pay X[credit] to place X advancement counters on 1 installed card.
cards.title: Focus Group

cards.text: Gain 2[credit] or draw 2 cards. Repeat this process for each remote server that has a card in its root and is protected by ice.
cards.title: Fully Operational

cards.text: Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn. Choose a Runner card type. Trash all installed non-icebreaker cards of the chosen type. For each card that would be trashed this way, the Runner may pay 3[credit] to prevent that card from being trashed. Take 1 bad publicity.
cards.title: Game Over

cards.text: When you install this program, it gets +3 strength for the remainder of the turn. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 2[credit]: +2 strength.
cards.title: Gauss

cards.text: This ice gets −1 strength for each installed icebreaker. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program that is not a decoder, fracter, or killer. [subroutine] End the run.
cards.title: Hagen

cards.text: The first time each turn you reveal a card, gain 1[credit]. [click]: Reveal 1 card from the grip at random or the top card of the stack.
cards.title: Hyoubu Institute: Absolute Clarity

cards.text:
Play only as your first [click].
For the remainder of this turn, whenever you install a card with a printed install cost of 1[credit] or greater, draw 1 card or gain 1[credit].
cards.title: In the Groove

cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this upgrade, remove 1 bad publicity unless they take 1 tag.
cards.title: Increased Drop Rates

cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, trash 1 installed resource.
Gain 7[credit].
cards.title: Isolation

cards.text: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, choose an install cost greater than 0[credit]. The Corp sets aside the top X cards of R&D faceup, where X is equal to the number of your installed cards with that printed install cost, up to 6. Access 1 of the set-aside cards. The Corp shuffles the set-aside cards into R&D.
cards.title: Khusyuk

cards.text: When your discard phase ends, if you have the same number of cards in your grip as the Corp has in HQ, you may draw 1 card.
cards.title: Lat: Ethical Freelancer

cards.text: The first time the Runner approaches this server during each run, play a Psi Game. (Players secretly bid 0–2[credit]. Then each player reveals and spends their bid.) If the bids differ, you may trash this upgrade. If you do, the Runner moves to the outermost position of this server. They may jack out.
cards.title: Letheia Nisei

cards.text:
[subroutine] End the run unless the Runner pays 2[credit].
[subroutine] Reveal the top 3 cards of the stack. Add 1 of those cards to the grip and gain X[credit], where X is equal to that cardʼs play or install cost. The Runner shuffles the stack. Trash this ice.
cards.title: Loot Box

cards.text: [interrupt] → Remove this hardware from the game: Prevent a Corp card ability from ending the run. Use this ability only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn.
cards.title: Lucky Charm

cards.text: +1[mu] The first time each turn you install a piece of hardware, draw 1 card. Whenever a run begins, you may install 1 piece of hardware from your grip, paying 1[credit] more. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.title: Masterwork (v37)

cards.text: If the first, second, and third actions you take on your turn are each different from one another, when the third action completes, you may gain 1[credit] or take another different action, paying [click] less.
cards.title: MirrorMorph: Endless Iteration

cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Gain 2[credit]. When the Runner trashes this asset, you may gain 2[credit].
cards.title: Nanoetching Matrix

cards.text: When you install this program, place 2 virus counters on it. Once per turn → Hosted virus counter: Choose an ice subtype. The ice you are encountering gains that subtype for the remainder of this encounter.
cards.title: Pelangi

cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each hosted advancement counter past 3. Hosted agenda counter: Swap 1 card from HQ with 1 card in the root of or protecting the attacked server. The Runner may jack out. Use this ability only during a run.
cards.title: Project Yagi-Uda

cards.text: When your turn begins, reveal the top card of R&D and gain 2[credit].
cards.title: Public Health Portal

cards.text:
Resolve 2 of the following in any order:
  • Draw 2 cards.
  • Gain 2[credit].
  • Install 1 non-agenda card from HQ.
  • Gain [click].
cards.title: Red Level Clearance

cards.text:
When you rez this upgrade, you may pay up to 4[credit] to place that many power counters on it.
As an additional cost to run this server, the Runner must pay 2[credit] for each hosted power counter.
Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on a central server, remove 1 hosted power counter.
cards.title: Reduced Service

cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, add 1 installed program or piece of hardware to your grip.
Install 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip, paying X[credit] less. X is equal to the printed install cost of the card you added to your grip.
cards.title: Rejig

cards.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it. Hosted agenda counter: Place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.
cards.title: Remastered Edition

cards.text: When your turn begins, gain 1[credit].
cards.title: Rezeki

cards.text:
During runs against this server, you can rez this ice any time you could rez non-ice cards.
Each piece of ice protecting this server gets +1 strength.
[subroutine] The Runner loses 1[credit].
cards.title: Rime

cards.text: [click][click][click]: Gain 6[credit]. You may remove 1 bad publicity.
cards.title: Roughneck Repair Squad

cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, choose a card type. For the remainder of the encounter, whenever you trash a card of the chosen type with net damage from a subroutine on this ice, do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
cards.title: Saisentan

cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, place 1 virus counter on it.
This ice gets −1 strength for each hosted virus counter.
[subroutine] End the run.
cards.title: Sandstone

cards.text:
As an additional cost to steal this agenda, the Runner must trash 1 installed program.
When you score this agenda, trash 1 installed program.
cards.title: SDS Drone Deployment

cards.text: As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click]. Search R&D for 1 piece of ice and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Install that ice protecting a central server, paying 3[credit] less.
cards.title: Secure and Protect

cards.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, trash 1 installed program.
Gain 4[credit] and draw 2 cards.
cards.title: Spec Work

cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, reveal the top 3 cards of R&D. Trash 1 of the revealed cards.
cards.title: Stargate

cards.text: When a player scores or steals this agenda, do X net damage. X is equal to 1 plus the number of copies of Sting! in the other playerʼs score area.
cards.title: Sting!

cards.text: The first time each turn you trash a card that matches the faction of the Runnerʼs identity (from any location), place 1 power counter on this asset. [click], hosted power counter: Do 1 net damage.
cards.title: Storgotic Resonator

cards.text: +2[mu] You get +1 maximum hand size. When your turn ends, if you and the Corp have the same number of credits, you may gain 2[credit]. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.title: Supercorridor

cards.text: Once per turn → [click]: Gain 2[credit]. Once per turn → [click]: Install 1 program or piece of hardware from your grip, paying 1[credit] less.
cards.title: The Artist

cards.text:
When a discard phase ends, if you installed this resource this turn, draw 4 cards.
[interrupt] → The first time each turn you would draw any number of cards, look at the top X cards of your stack. Add 1 of those cards to the bottom of your stack. X is equal to the number of cards you would draw plus 1.
cards.title: The Class Act

cards.text: The first time each turn you install a virus program, place 2 virus counters on this resource. When your turn begins, you may remove any 2 virus counters from your installed cards. If you do, draw 2 cards unless the Corp trashes the top card of R&D.
cards.title: The Nihilist

cards.text: The first time each turn a run begins, gain 1[credit].
cards.title: Tiered Subscription

cards.text:
When you rez this ice, take 1 bad publicity.
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed Runner card.
[subroutine] Trace[6]. If successful, the Runner cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.
cards.title: Trebuchet

cards.text:
When your turn begins and whenever you steal an agenda, place 1[credit] on this resource.
You can spend hosted credits to use programs during runs.
When your turn ends, if there are 3 or more hosted credits, you must take 1 tag or trash this resource.
cards.title: Trickster Taka

cards.text: Interface → X[credit]: Break X code gate subroutines. Use this ability only once per run. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. Use this ability only if you have 3 or more installed virtual resources. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
cards.title: Utae

cards.text: You cannot score this agenda if it was installed this turn.
cards.title: Vulnerability Audit

cards.text: Whenever you make a successful run, you may trash this resource to choose a card name. The next time this run you access an agenda with the chosen name, steal it, ignoring all costs. (You are no longer accessing it.)
cards.title: Whistleblower

“Net space is an abstraction, a white lie protecting fragile comprehensions. Do not limit yourself.” —z\h/r
Sing, sing as your heart desires!
Friends break your walls.
“…well, I’m laughing.”
Friends hide your fears.
“You’re not listening.”

—Az McCaffrey

—“Baklan” Bochkin

—“Baklan” Bochkin
“…but I am without compare.”
Letʼs do it fast fast, then back to mine for tuak.
Do you know how many food deliveries I’ve missed this week?

“There is never a wasted program. Someone, somewhere, will have a use for that code. Even corps are scrambling for quick fixes nowadays.”
—Lat
The Net is boundless, but the right access port is worth a road trip.
It is not knowledge, but the act of learning, not possession, but the act of getting there, which grants the greatest enjoyment.
It makes sysops see red. And orange, yellow, green…

“It takes such simple things to sustain us, the most important of which is to be thankful.”
—Lat
“…then let me paint you a picture.”
Get into the ducts on the roof and keep crawling till you hit that old network root. Dirty work, I know, but it beats playing by the rules.
I didn’t say your hopper should be hauling garbage. I said it should be hauled away as garbage.

—Lat
Reflection, Not Imitation.

“Early success should be rewarded, as it will encourage a culture of drive and competition.”
—Corporate Leadership for Dummies
Unit is holding .78 asimovs of stress potential in all three directive logic traps. Psychiatric session mandated during next maintenance cycle.
At the scale where nanobots cut glass, quantum mechanics dictate error. A silicon atom here, an oxygen there, an erbium out of place. Each bioroid is born unique.
Old warriors have seen all the tricks; be forthright or fail.
Haas’ unsecured servers were fortified just before the storm. Are their bioroid oracles that good, or were they tipped off?
Not all secrets lie in vaults.
The Net abhors a vacuum. Any unexplained gap must be made.
No Stone Unturned.

“‘It is my nature,’ said the scorpion.”
—Conceptual Frameworks in Bio-Ethics and Synthetic Morality, Moser University Press
Hyoubu is our vanguard in the battle for hearts and minds.

“Memory is a tangle of emotional threads. Pull one, it twists a second, unravels a third!”
—Letheia Nisei

Anyway I won.

—Chief “Pinchy” Wilson

“There’s something about the human touch that androids will never replace.”
—Mila Braun

Effective, Cheap, Durable. Pick two.

—Elizabeth Mills
